title: Get playable assets
content_data:
Use this endpoint to get a list of playable assets. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/playable/get/|/v1.3/playable/get/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number
`playable_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string
`playable_id`: string| |Response parameter data type|`advertiser_id`: number
`playable_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string
`playable_id`: string| |New response parameters|/|`operation_status`| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/playable/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | Access-Token {Required} | string | Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | advertiser_id {required} | string | Advertiser ID. | |playable_id|string|Playable asset ID to filter the results by.| |playable_name|string|Playable asset name to filter the results by.| |playable_url|string|Playable URL.| |status|string|Playable asset status .

Enum values:`AUDIT_FAIL`, `AUDIT_SUCCESS`,`VALIDATE_FAIL`,`VALIDATE_SUCCESS`,`VALIDATING`.| |operation_status|string|Playable asset operation status.

Enum values:`UPLOADED`,`SAVED`,`DELETED`.
Default value: `SAVED`.| |page|number|Current number of pages.

Value range: ≥ 1.
Default value: 1.| |page_size|number|Page size.

Value range: 1-100.
Default value: 10. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/playable/get/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&page=1&page_size=100' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|Return message. For details, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | request_id | string |The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| |data |object|Returned data.| #|list|object []|Playable asset list.| ##|advertiser_id|string|Advertiser ID.| ##|playable_id|string|Playable asset ID.| ##|playable_url|string|Playable URL.| ##|playable_name|string|Playable asset name.| ##|playable_orientation|string|Playable asset orientation .

Enum values:
  • `BOTH`: vertical or horizontal.
  • `LANDSCAPE`: horizontal.
  • `PORTRAIT`: vertical.
| ##|status|string|Playable asset status.

Enum values:`AUDIT_FAIL`,`AUDIT_SUCCESS`, `VALIDATE_FAIL`, `VALIDATE_SUCCESS`,`VALIDATING`.| ##|operation_status|string|Playable asset operation status.

Enum values:`UPLOADED`,`SAVED`,`DELETED`.| #|page_info |object | Pagination information. | ##|page |number | Current page number. | ##|page_size |number | Page size. | ##|total_number |number | Total number of results. | ##|total_page |number |Total pages of results. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "operation_status": "SAVED", "playable_id": "{{playable_id}}", "playable_name": "{{playable_name}}", "playable_orientation": "BOTH", "playable_url": "{{playable_url}}", "status": "VALIDATE_SUCCESS" } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 100, "total_number": 1, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code); ```
